el-textarea.allowances: No `role` other than textbox, which is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global `aria-*` attributes and any `aria-*` attributes applicable to the `textbox` role.

el-tfoot.allowances: Any `role`, though rowgroup is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global `aria-*` attributes and any `aria-*` attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-th.allowances: If the ancestor `table` element has `role=table`, `grid`, or `treegrid`, no `role` other than the following: If the ancestor `table` element is exposed as a `role=table`, then columnheader, `rowheader` and `cell` are allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED. If the ancestor `table` element is exposed as a `role=grid` or `treegrid`, then columnheader, `rowheader` or `gridcell` are allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED. Otherwise, if the ancestor `table` element is not exposed as a `role=table`, `grid` or `treegrid`, any `role`. Global `aria-*` attributes and any `aria-*` attributes applicable to the allowed roles.
el-th.implicit: role=columnheader, `rowheader` or `cell` if the ancestor `table` element is exposed as a `role=table` role=columnheader, `rowheader` or `gridcell` if the ancestor `table` element is exposed as a `role=grid` or `treegrid` No corresponding role if the ancestor `table` element is not exposed as a `role=table`, `grid` or `treegrid`

el-thead.allowances: Any `role`, though rowgroup is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global `aria-*` attributes and any `aria-*` attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-time.allowances: Any `role`, though time is NOT RECOMMENDED. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global `aria-*` attributes and any `aria-*` attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-tr.allowances: If the ancestor `table` element has `role=table`, `grid`, or `treegrid`, no `role` other than row, which is NOT RECOMMENDED; otherwise any `role`, though row is NOT RECOMMENDED. Global `aria-*` attributes and any `aria-*` attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-u.allowances: Any `role`, though generic SHOULD NOT be used. Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global `aria-*` attributes and any `aria-*` attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-ul.allowances: Roles: `group`, `listbox`, `menu`, `menubar`, `none`, `presentation`, `radiogroup`, `tablist`, `toolbar` or `tree`. (list is also allowed, but NOT RECOMMENDED.) Global `aria-*` attributes and any `aria-*` attributes applicable to the allowed roles. Authors SHOULD NOT use the deprecated `directory` role.

el-var.allowances: Any `role` Naming Prohibited Otherwise, global `aria-*` attributes and any `aria-*` attributes applicable to the allowed roles.

el-video.allowances: Role: `application` Global `aria-*` attributes and any `aria-*` attributes applicable to the `application` role.

el-wbr.allowances: Roles: `none` or `presentation` Authors MAY specify the `aria-hidden` attribute on the `wbr` element. Otherwise, no other allowed `aria-*` attributes.
